messages.subject: Re: forrtl: error (65): floating invalid
parts:
Thank you, Tam. Solved!

The model was working well in SWAT+ and when using the release executable. That is why I thought it might be related to R-SWAT.
However, I managed to make it work in R-SWAT as well by deleting the soil parameters (i.e., albedo and bulk density) from the calibration parameter table.
